places.name: Stanley Park
places.ai_summary: Stanley Park is a world-renowned urban park offering scenic views, walking trails, and cultural landmarks.
places.place_tip: Rent a bike to explore the seawall.
places.address: Stanley Park, Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada

places.name: Whistler Blackcomb
places.ai_summary: Whistler Blackcomb is a premier ski resort offering world-class skiing, snowboarding, and year-round activities.
places.place_tip: Book lift tickets in advance to save money.
places.address: Whistler, British Columbia, Canada

places.name: Capilano Suspension Bridge
places.ai_summary: The Capilano Suspension Bridge is a popular attraction offering breathtaking views of the Capilano River and surrounding forest.

opening_hours.notes: Check for seasonal events like the Canyon Lights.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking.

places.ai_summary: Butchart Gardens is a stunning garden destination featuring a variety of plants, flowers, and themed gardens.

places.name: Granville Island
places.ai_summary: Granville Island is a vibrant shopping district known for its public market, artisan shops, and waterfront dining.

places.address: Granville Island, Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada

places.name: Sea-to-Sky Highway
places.ai_summary: The Sea-to-Sky Highway is a scenic drive between Vancouver and Whistler, offering breathtaking views of the coast and mountains.
